description: RFC 5280 §6.1.5(b) requires explicit_policy = min(explicit_policy, requireExplicitPolicy) for the leaf cert's PolicyConstraints. The current code only handles == 0 case; a leaf cert with requireExplicitPolicy = 1 is silently ignored. Intermediates use the correct min() clamp at lines 2364-2366. Fix: apply explicit_policy = explicit_policy.min(req) in the §6.1.5(b) block. File: pkix-path/src/lib.rs ~lines 2526-2533.
title: path: leaf PolicyConstraints requireExplicitPolicy clamp is incomplete
